text:
Ivy (AE): Heads-up: Prospect wants a 2-week pilot with EU-only data plane, BYOK, and a dated subprocessor snapshot for the pilot window. They also want a no-auto-failover clause. Can we scope + price?
Ravi (SE): Clarify: control-plane metadata okay to leave global? They said yes as long as payloads/logs/traces stay in EU.
Ivy (AE): Correct. Logs and traces must be EU-resident for the POC.
Kim (Ops): We can pin tenant to eu-west-1 and restrict routing to EU pools. BYOK via KMS connector in eu-west is supported. BYO-HSM is out-of-scope for 2 weeks. Need to confirm which quantized variants exist in EU.
Asha (Security): I'll prepare the attestation + SCQ entries. Ops: need a dated CSV snapshot of subprocessors touching the request path for the POC dates, and confirmation we can flip observability exports to EU-only. Also adding 24h notice clause for any manual cross-border failover.
Noah (Pricing): Regional pinning + BYOK + reserved capacity = infra uplift. Ballpark for 2 weeks: ~€6k-10k. Will post formal quote after pool sizing.
Ravi (SE): Proposed minimal POC config:
```
tenant_id: prospect-poc-1765559999
residency: EU
primary_pool: eu-west-1
kms: external_key_arn -> map via connector
routing: strict_residency=true
fallback: queue_notify
observability: sink=obs-eu.redwood
```
Kim (Ops): Note: strict_residency=true limits autoscale to EU pool; if saturated we queue or 429. Manual failover requires signed approval and 24h notice. I'll produce subprocessor CSV dated for the POC.
deploy-bot: residency-pin apply requested for tenant prospect-poc-1765559999 -> job#10012 queued
Ivy (AE): Action items: Ravi draft tech packet + eval prompts. Kim produce subprocessors snapshot and confirm model availability. Asha finalize attestation & SCQ. Noah post quote. I'll send packet to customer once complete. :thumbsup:
